title: Agent Access
description: Register Workspace-level Clients for third-party Web / Apps, manage Credential rotation, and grant Agent data-plane scopes.
readonlyNotice: Your Workspace role is view-only for access config. Create, rotate, and revoke require OWNER or ADMIN.
dangerDisableClientDesc: Existing tokens become invalid on security-version or SSE revalidation; new requests are rejected immediately.
dangerRevokeGrantDesc: The business platform immediately loses all Scopes granted for this Agent; active event streams are revalidated.
dangerRevokeCredentialDesc: Credential revocation cannot be undone. Confirm a replacement Credential is available to avoid platform outage.
loadFailed: Failed to load Agent Access config. Please try again later.
privateKeyClientRegistered: Private Key Client registered; ActWeave did not generate or store the private key.
createClientFailed: Failed to create Client. Check auth configuration.
jwkRotated: New JWK registered; the previous Credential expires when the overlap window ends.
rotateFailed: Credential rotation failed. Refresh and retry.
grantCreated: Agent grant created and written to the audit log.
grantCreateFailed: Failed to create Agent grant. Check Scope conflicts or expiry.
enableClientFailed: Failed to enable Client; ensure at least one active Credential exists.
dangerExecuted: High-risk change applied; security version updated.
revokeFailed: Revoke failed. Refresh resource versions and retry.
secretCopied: Copied. Save it to a controlled password manager now—it cannot be viewed again after you close this window.
emptyBody: Register a Client to issue independent Credentials and Agent Scopes for third-party platforms.
exportHandoffAria: Export AAP integration config for a third party
exportIntro: Give the integrator Workspace, Client, Agent, and Scope in one packet. The Client Secret is never included.
exportSecretNote: The secret is shown once at creation or credential rotation. The integrator must paste AAP_CLIENT_SECRET into their own secret store.
exportBaseUrlHint: Defaults to this console origin plus the AAP path. Edit it before copy if the public AAP entrypoint is different.
exportGrantAria: Select the Agent grant to export
exportNoGrant: No Agent is granted yet. A Client ID alone cannot mint a token — create a Grant first.
credentialsBody: Only public hints and usage times are shown; auth material is non-recoverable. Rotate or revoke Credentials here.
noCredentialsBody: Public hints appear here after you rotate or create a Client.
grantsBody: Each Grant only includes controlled data-plane Scopes—no Workspace admin powers.
noGrantsBody: Create a least-privilege Grant for the business platform, binding callable Agents and Scopes.
configBody: These values participate in browser access, JWT validation, and external Subject trust boundaries.
configNote: Auth method and trust roots are security boundaries. In v1, change them by registering a new Client—do not silently replace the existing Client.
corsOrigins: CORS Origins (one exact HTTPS origin per line)
overlapHint: Finish switching the business platform before the window ends.
serviceDecision: Allow pure Service Principal for low-risk approvals
serviceDecisionHint: Only when Agent Policy also allows LOW / MEDIUM risk.
secretWarning: This is the only plaintext display for {context}. ActWeave does not store plaintext; it cannot be recovered after you close this window.
secretSavedClose: I have saved it securely — close
